items.en: I can identify the things that really matter to me in life and pursue them.
items.zh_working: 我能找出生活中真正重要的事，并去追求它们。

items.en: One of my big goals is to be free from painful emotions.
items.zh_working: 我的一大目标就是摆脱痛苦的情绪。

items.en: I rush through meaningful activities without being really attentive to them.
items.zh_working: 我匆匆做完有意义的活动，却没有真正留心。

items.en: I try to stay busy to keep thoughts or feelings from coming.
items.zh_working: 我尽量让自己忙起来，好让那些想法或感受不要冒出来。

items.en: I act in ways that are consistent with how I wish to live my life.
items.zh_working: 我的行为方式与我想要的生活一致。

items.en: I get so caught up in my thoughts that I am unable to do the things that I most want to do.
items.zh_working: 我陷在自己的想法里，以至于做不成自己最想做的事。

items.en: I make choices based on what is important to me, even if it is stressful.
items.zh_working: 即使有压力，我也基于对自己重要的东西来做选择。

items.en: I tell myself that I shouldn't have certain thoughts.
items.zh_working: 我告诉自己，我不应该有某些念头。

items.en: I find it difficult to stay focused on what's happening in the present.
items.zh_working: 我很难把注意力放在当下正在发生的事上。

items.en: I behave in line with my personal values.
items.zh_working: 我的行为与自己的个人价值观一致。

items.en: I go out of my way to avoid situations that might bring difficult thoughts, feelings, or sensations.
items.zh_working: 我刻意回避那些可能带来困难想法、感受或身体感觉的情境。

items.en: Even when doing the things that matter to me, I find myself doing them without paying attention.
items.zh_working: 即使在做对自己重要的事，我也会发现自己心不在焉。

items.en: I am willing to fully experience whatever thoughts, feelings and sensations come up for me, without trying to change or defend against them.
items.zh_working: 我愿意完整地体验出现的一切想法、感受和身体感觉，不去改变或防御它们。

items.en: I undertake things that are meaningful to me, even when I find it hard to do so.
items.zh_working: 即使困难，我也会去做对自己有意义的事。

items.en: I work hard to keep out upsetting feelings.
items.zh_working: 我很努力地把难受的感受挡在外面。

items.en: I do jobs or tasks automatically, without being aware of what I'm doing.
items.zh_working: 我自动化地完成任务，意识不到自己在做什么。

items.en: I am able to follow my long terms plans including times when progress is slow.
items.zh_working: 即使进展缓慢，我也能坚持执行自己的长期计划。

items.en: Even when something is important to me, I'll rarely do it if there is a chance it will upset me.
items.zh_working: 即使一件事对我重要，只要它可能让我难受，我就很少去做。

items.en: It seems I am 'running on automatic' without much awareness of what I'm doing.
items.zh_working: 我好像在“自动运行”，不太觉察自己在做什么。

items.en: Thoughts are just thoughts - they don't control what I do.
items.zh_working: 想法只是想法——它们控制不了我的行动。

items.en: My values are really reflected in my behavior.
items.zh_working: 我的价值观确实体现在我的行为里。

items.en: I can take thoughts and feelings as they come, without attempting to control or avoid them.
items.zh_working: 我能让想法和感受自然来去，不试图控制或回避它们。

items.en: I can keep going with something when it's important to me.
items.zh_working: 只要事情对我重要，我就能坚持做下去。

scores.label: 心理灵活性总分（23题）
scores.description: 12 个负向键题按 6−原始分反向后与全部题目相加，范围 0–138。分数越高表示越多报告心理灵活性。

scores.label: 对体验的开放（OE，10题反向后）
scores.description: OE 十题（其中九题负向键反向）求和，范围 0–60；越高表示越多报告允许想法和感受存在。

scores.label: 对行为的觉察（BA，5题反向后）
scores.description: BA 五题（全部负向键反向）求和，范围 0–30；越高表示越多报告做事时留意当下。

scores.label: 价值行动（VA，8题）
scores.description: VA 八题（全部正向键）求和，范围 0–48；越高表示越多报告按价值行动。

missingPolicy: complete_required；任一题缺失则该分数不计算，不插补、不补0。
